question.text: As shown in the figure, a wire is bent to form a D-shaped loop, carrying current I, where the curved part is semi-circle of radius $\mathrm{R}$. the loop is placed in a uniform magnetic field $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{B}}$, which is directed into the plane of the paper. The magnetic force left by the closed loop is

solution.text:
Hint: 
Zero (Net magnetic force on a closed current loop in a uniform $\overrightarrow{\mathrm{B}}$ is zero)
